plugins.name: Bielson Battle Event (Pallet Town)
plugins.description: Adds a persistent 6v6 Level 70 boss battle against Bielson in Pallet Town for FireRed & LeafGreen (English & French Switch builds). Heals your party before and after, rewards 1 Master Ball once per save, allows rematches, and includes a safe remover.
plugins.author: gfaraujosousa

plugins.name: Static Legendary Respawn (Gen 3)
plugins.description: Respawn static legendaries in FireRed, LeafGreen (all 12 Switch builds) and Emerald (including Emerald Swap) so you can encounter or shiny-hunt them again without erasing caught Pokemon or Pokedex entries.
plugins.author: gfaraujosousa

plugins.name: Gen 3 QoL: R-Toggle Turbo & Key Rare Candy
plugins.description: Quality-of-life pack for FireRed, LeafGreen (all 12 Switch builds) and Emerald (including Emerald Swap): tap R to toggle up to 8x speed (with lag/fade guards and persistent restore via Mom on FRLG or the 2F Mystery Gift Delivery Man on Emerald) plus a reusable Rare Candy placed safely in Key Items.
plugins.author: gfaraujosousa

plugins.name: Shiny Static Legendary RNG (Gen 3)
plugins.description: Guarantees a legal Method 1 shiny static legendary in FireRed, LeafGreen (all 12 Switch builds) and Emerald (including Emerald Swap) by advancing gRngValue to the next shiny state for your save's own TID/SID right before the encounter generates.
plugins.author: gfaraujosousa

plugins.name: Send the same one back
plugins.description: Trade a Pokemon and get the very same one back in that trade, so one that evolves by trade evolves on your console in a single trade. Works in every game pokeldn hosts a trade for.
plugins.author: gfaraujosousa
